Weight Decay Shrinks the Fit.zh: 权重衰减收缩拟合曲线

Hand a degree-9 polynomial a fistful of.zh: 给一个 9 次多项式一把含噪数据点，它会乐此不疲地穿过每一个点 — 并在点与点之间以极大的系数剧烈摆动。权重衰减增加了一项 $\lambda\lVert w\rVert^{2}$，对大的权重@@T0@@课税@@T1@@。转动下方 $\lambda$ 旋钮，观察狂野的曲线趋于平静、系数坍缩，测试误差滑入其最佳区间。
Hand a degree-9 polynomial a fistful of.src: Hand a degree-9 polynomial a fistful of noisy points and it will happily thread every one — wiggling violently between them with enormous coefficients. Weight decay adds one term, $\lambda\lVert w\rVert^{2}$, that taxes big weights. Turn the $\lambda$ knob below and watch the wild curve calm down, the coefficients collapse, and the test error slide into its sweet spot.

@@T0@@~10 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Le.zh:
@@T0@@约 10 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 泛化 · 正则化@@T3@@

One extra term in the loss.zh: 损失函数中多出的一项
One extra term in the loss.src: One extra term in the loss

Ordinary least squares picks weights $w$.zh: 普通最小二乘选取使训练数据平方误差最小的权重 $w$。而岭回归 — 即线性模型中@@T0@@权重衰减@@T1@@的名称 — 则额外增加一项与 $w$ 的平方长度成正比的惩罚：
Ordinary least squares picks weights $w$.src: Ordinary least squares picks weights $w$ that minimize the squared error on the training data. Ridge regression — the linear-model name for weight decay — adds a penalty proportional to the squared length of $w$:

Because this is quadratic in $w$, there.zh: 由于该式对 $w$ 是二次的，故存在闭式最优解 — 无需梯度下降。令梯度为零即得岭回归的@@T0@@正规方程@@T1@@，本页将在你的浏览器中用一个微型高斯消元程序实时求解：
Because this is quadratic in $w$, there.src: Because this is quadratic in $w$, there is a closed-form minimizer — no gradient descent required. Setting the gradient to zero gives the ridge normal equations, which this page solves live in your browser with a tiny Gaussian-elimination routine:

Here $\\Phi$ is the design matrix whose.zh:
这里 $\Phi$ 是设计矩阵，其各行即多项式特征
      $\phi(x) = [1, x, x^2, \dots, x^d]$。单一旋钮 $\lambda$ 在两个极端之间插值：当 $\lambda \to 0$ 时，你得到狂野的插值拟合；当 $\lambda \to \infty$ 时，所有权重都被压向零，曲线趋于一条水平直线。
Here $\\Phi$ is the design matrix whose.src:
Here $\Phi$ is the design matrix whose rows are the polynomial features
      $\phi(x) = [1, x, x^2, \dots, x^d]$. The single knob $\lambda$ interpolates
      between two extremes: at $\lambda \to 0$ you recover the wild interpolating fit;
      as $\lambda \to \infty$ every weight is crushed toward zero and the curve flattens
      to a constant.

Turn the knob, watch the fit.src: Turn the knob, watch the fit

Fifteen noisy points (orange) are sample.zh: 十五个含噪点（橙色）由一条光滑的真实曲线（灰色虚线）采样得到。用一个 9 次多项式做岭回归拟合。在其对数标度上拖动 $\lambda$：最左端是近乎零的惩罚（狂野过拟合），最右端是重惩罚（平坦的欠拟合）。三个预设可让你直接跳到这些有意思的区域。
Fifteen noisy points (orange) are sample.src:
Fifteen noisy points (orange) are sampled from a smooth true curve (grey dashed).
      A degree-9 polynomial is fit by ridge regression. Drag $\lambda$ on its log scale:
      far left is almost-zero penalty (wild overfit), far right is a heavy penalty
      (flat underfit). The three presets jump you to the interesting regimes.

The fitted degree-$d$ polynomial (blue).zh: 拟合得到的 $d$ 次多项式（蓝色）与真实函数（灰色虚线）及含噪训练样本（橙色）的对比。竖直方向的夸张部分被裁剪至画框内。
The fitted degree-$d$ polynomial (blue).src:
The fitted degree-$d$ polynomial (blue) against the true function (grey dashed)
        and the noisy training sample (orange). A vertical exaggeration is clipped to the frame.

$\\lVert w\\rVert^{2}$ versus $\\lambda$.zh: $\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ 随 $\lambda$ 的变化（两轴均为对数）。惩罚越大 → 权重越小，且单调。
$\\lVert w\\rVert^{2}$ versus $\\lambda$.src: $\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ versus $\lambda$ (both log axes). Bigger penalty → smaller weights, monotonically.

Train (blue) vs test (green) error versu.zh: 训练误差（蓝色）与测试误差（绿色）随 $\lambda$ 的变化。测试误差呈 U 形 — 圆点标出你当前的 $\lambda$。
Train (blue) vs test (green) error versu.src: Train (blue) vs test (green) error versus $\lambda$. Test error is a U — the dot marks your current $\lambda$.

The learned coefficients $w_1,\\dots,w_d.zh: 学到的系数 $w_1,\dots,w_d$（偏置 $w_0$ 不受惩罚，已隐藏）。随着 $\lambda$ 增大，观察每根柱子如何坍向零。
The learned coefficients $w_1,\\dots,w_d.src: The learned coefficients $w_1,\dots,w_d$ (the bias $w_0$ is not penalized and is hidden). Watch every bar collapse toward zero as $\lambda$ grows.

@@T0@@Start at \"Overfit.\"@@T1@@ The bl.zh:
@@T0@@从「过拟合」开始。@@T1@@ 蓝色曲线蜿蜒穿过几乎每一个
      橙色点，但在点之间它冲向 $\pm\infty$；权重范数的数值大得惊人，测试误差远高于训练误差。现在向右拖动
      $\lambda$：曲线松弛并贴合真实的灰色曲线，系数柱收缩，测试误差降到谷底，随后曲线最终变得平坦。
@@T0@@Start at \"Overfit.\"@@T1@@ The bl.src: Start at "Overfit." The blue curve snakes through nearly every orange dot, but between them it lunges toward $\pm\infty$; the weight-norm number is astronomical and the test error is far above the train error. Now drag $\lambda$ right: the curve relaxes onto the true grey curve, the coefficient bars shrink, and test error drops into the trough before the curve finally goes flat.

Why smaller weights generalize better.zh: 为何更小的权重泛化更好

A high-degree polynomial is not @@T0@@to.zh:
高次多项式并非因为项数多而@@T0@@过于复杂@@T1@@
      — 其危险在于这些项可能取值@@T2@@巨大且相互抵消@@T3@@。$x^7$ 上 $+40{,}000$ 的系数与 $x^9$ 上 $-38{,}000$ 的系数相互对抗，正是剧烈波动的来源。惩罚 $\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ 恰好禁止了这类巨大而微妙平衡的权重，于是剩下的可行拟合都是平滑的。
A high-degree polynomial is not @@T0@@to.src: A high-degree polynomial is not too complex because it has many terms — it is dangerous because those terms can take on huge, canceling values. A coefficient of $+40{,}000$ on $x^7$ fighting $-38{,}000$ on $x^9$ is what produces the violent wiggles. Penalizing $\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ forbids exactly those enormous, delicately balanced weights, so the only fits left are smooth ones.

@@T0@@Bias&ndash;variance, made visible..zh: @@T0@@偏差-方差的直观呈现。@@T1@@ 小 $\lambda$ = 低偏差、高方差（拟合了噪声）。大 $\lambda$ = 高偏差、低方差（连信号也一并忽略）。U 形的测试曲线正是这一权衡，其最小值就是你所需要的 $\lambda$。
@@T0@@Bias&ndash;variance, made visible..src: Bias–variance, made visible. Small $\lambda$ = low bias, high variance (fits the noise). Large $\lambda$ = high bias, low variance (ignores signal too). The U-shaped test curve is that trade-off, and its minimum is the $\lambda$ you want.

@@T0@@Same math as an MAP prior.@@T1@@ $.zh: @@T0@@与 MAP 先验在数学上相同。@@T1@@ $\lambda\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ 即高斯先验 $w \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \tfrac{1}{2\lambda}I)$ 的对数。权重衰减不过是向零的贝叶斯收缩。
@@T0@@Same math as an MAP prior.@@T1@@ $.src: Same math as an MAP prior. $\lambda\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ is the log of a Gaussian prior $w \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \tfrac{1}{2\lambda}I)$. Weight decay is just Bayesian shrinkage toward zero.

@@T0@@Why \"decay.\"@@T1@@ In gradient d.zh: @@T0@@为何称为「衰减」。@@T1@@ 在梯度下降中，惩罚项为每一步额外加上 $-2\eta\lambda\,w$，即在数据驱动的更新之前，每个权重都会乘以 $(1-2\eta\lambda)<1$ — 它确实在每一步中向零衰减。
@@T0@@Why \"decay.\"@@T1@@ In gradient d.src: Why "decay." In gradient descent the penalty adds $-2\eta\lambda\,w$ to each step, i.e. every weight is multiplied by $(1-2\eta\lambda)<1$ before the data-driven update — it literally decays toward zero each step.

@@T0@@In deep nets.@@T1@@ There is no cl.zh:
@@T0@@在深度网络中。@@T1@@ 虽无闭式解，但思路完全相同：
      在损失中加入 $\lambda\lVert w\rVert^{2}$（或使用优化器的
      @@T2@@weight_decay@@T3@@ 参数）。它是最廉价、最可靠的正则化手段之一 — 只需一个数值，即可换来更平滑的函数以及更小的训练与测试性能差距。
@@T0@@In deep nets.@@T1@@ There is no cl.src: In deep nets. There is no closed form, but the idea is identical: add $\lambda\lVert w\rVert^{2}$ to the loss (or use an optimizer's weight_decay argument). It is one of the cheapest, most reliable regularizers there is — a single number that buys you a smoother function and a smaller gap between training and test performance.

meta.title: 权重衰减收缩拟合曲线
meta.tagline: 加入一项惩罚，即 lambda 乘以权重范数的平方，观察狂野的过拟合如何平复为光滑且能泛化的曲线
meta.summary: 一个 9 次多项式穿过十五个含噪点，并以巨大的系数在点之间剧烈摆动。岭回归加入一项 lambda 乘以 ||w||^2 的惩罚，对大的权重课税。在对数标度上拖动 lambda，从近零（狂野过拟合）到较大（平坦欠拟合），观察拟合曲线松弛贴合真实函数、系数柱坍向零、||w||^2 单调收缩，以及测试误差勾勒出经典的 U 形最佳区间。岭回归正规方程由一个微型高斯消元求解器以闭式实时求解。
highlights: 在一个对数刻度的 lambda 滑块上从狂野过拟合拖到平坦欠拟合，实时观察 9 次岭回归拟合松弛并贴合真实曲线。
观察 ||w||^2 随 lambda 增大而单调收缩，以双对数坐标绘制，并在当前惩罚处设有实时标记。
观察训练与测试误差勾勒出经典的偏差-方差 U 形，其中测试误差的最小值标出你真正想要的 lambda。
系数柱状图展示每个权重都坍向零，从而揭示过拟合意味着巨大的相互抵消的系数，而不只是项数多。
岭回归正规方程 (Phi^T Phi + lambda I) w = Phi^T y 在浏览器中由一个微型高斯消元程序以闭式求解。
